newsitem.title: FRANCE: Colas to raise capital for Screg buy.
newsitem.headline: Colas to raise capital for Screg buy.

text.p: Road construction group Colas is increasing its share capital to 291.6 million francs from 257.33 million by issuing 857,774 shares at 590 francs, raising 506 million francs, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Subscription to the 40-franc nominal shares is open between October 29 and November 13 and shareholders have the right to buy two new shares for every 15 held.
The share issue is part of plans to finance the 1.4 billion franc acquisition of road builder Screg. Colas also plans to issue a 500 million franc bond in the coming weeks.
The CFTR, a full unit of Bouygues, has 59.40 percent of the shares in Colas and will take-up 67 percent of its rights, raising the capital by 200 million francs.
Royal Dutch Shell, which has eight percent of Colas, will subscribe to all its rights.
